title: Signal: Gemfile resolves a gem from a local path
scope: A Gemfile file that declares a gem that installs from a directory on the build machine.
limitations: It matches a gem that installs from a directory on the build machine in the parsed Gemfile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A Gemfile that mentions a gem that installs from a directory on the build machine in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
